;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least 11 people are killed following an explosion in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/8-killed-car-bomb-mogadishu-190328110849696.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[Maritime Squadron of the Armed Forces of Malta|Maltese Navy]] seizes control of commercial tanker ''[[Elhiblu 1]]'', which was hijacked by migrants off the coast of [[Libya]] yesterday. The tanker is now docked in the Maltese capital, [[Valletta]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47730693 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
* [[WOW air]], an [[Iceland]]ic low-cost airline, ceases operations. [https://www.icetra.is/about/press-room/news/end-of-operation-of-wow-air (Icelandic Transport Authority)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/icelandic-budget-airline-wow-air-ceases-operations-1.5074662 (CBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 18 people have died after a truck struck a crowd gathered at a [[List of traffic collisions (2000–present)|road accident]] in western [[Guatemala]]. The group had apparently gathered on the road to inspect a person who had been killed in a separate crash when the vehicle ploughed into them. The estimates of those dead were later revised by officials. [https://news.sky.com/story/30-dead-after-truck-hits-crowd-in-guatemala-11676960 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-crash/at-least-32-killed-in-guatemala-as-truck-plows-into-crowd-idUSKCN1R90CB (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-47738483 (BBC News)]
*A fire breaks out in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], at a 22-story tower, killing at least 25 people and injuring more than 70 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47751005 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
* The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] rejects a request by gun rights activists to grant a temporary stay on the Trump administration's ban on [[bump stock]] attachments that allow semi-automatic firearms to be fired rapidly. The policy took effect Tuesday after a similar bid to delay implementation was rejected. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-guns/us-supreme-court-refuses-to-block-trumps-gun-bump-stock-ban-idUSKCN1R9230 (Reuters)]
*Judge [[John D. Bates]] of the Federal District Court for the District of Columbia, in a case filed by 11 states, strikes down the Trump administration rule broadly re-defining  an [[Health insurance in the United States#Association Health Plan (AHP)|Association Health Plan]] employer to include [[Self-employment|self-employed individuals]] with no employees because it  violates the [[Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974]] and the [[Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act|Affordable Care Act of 2010]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/court-deals-trump-second-blow-this-week-on-health-care/ar-BBVmQqV (''The New York Times'' via msn.com)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Venezuela]]n state [[comptroller]] Elvis Amoroso announces that opposition leader [[Juan Guaidó]] is barred from holding public office for 15 years because of irregularities in his financial records. Guaidó, the [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]] [[President of the National Assembly of Venezuela|President]], says he will continue his campaign to oust [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/juan-guaido-venezuelan-opposition-leader-barred-from-holding-office-for-15-years-live-updates-2019-03-28/ (CBS News)]
